info.title: Plano do jogo de skate 3D para Android

messages.text:
"Plano do jogo de skate 3D para AndroidDecisão técnicaUse Godot 4.x, GDScript e o renderer Compatibility ou Mobile. O projeto será um jogo de skate 3D original, inspirado em jogos de skate com controle analógico, manobras, gaps, grinds, manuals e quedas. Não copie o mapa, os personagens, os nomes, os logotipos, a interface, os sons ou os modelos de Skate 3. Mesmo que o jogo seja apenas para uso pessoal, o caminho seguro é recriar as ideias de jogabilidade com um parque e uma identidade visual próprios.“Qualquer Android” precisa ser tratado como compatibilidade escalável, não como uma promessa de desempenho idêntico. O jogo deve ter três perfis: Baixo, para aparelhos antigos; Médio, para aparelhos intermediários; e Alto, para aparelhos recentes. O Android recomenda medir desempenho por modelo e por cena, usando ferramentas como Android GPU Inspector e Performance Tuner: https://developer.android.com/games/optimize/overviewA exportação Android do Godot exige configurar OpenJDK 17 e Android SDK; a documentação oficial lista os pacotes do SDK e também explica APK, AAB e assinatura: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.htmlEscopo inicial realistaComece com um único parque original de aproximadamente 600 x 600 metros jogáveis, não um mundo aberto infinito. Ele deve ter uma praça central, uma área de rua, um bowl, uma piscina vazia, escadas, corrimãos, bancos, rampas, um pequeno túnel e rotas de retorno. O mapa deve ser modular para que a qualidade baixa remova props decorativos sem alterar as linhas de skate.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
The user wants a complete 3D skateboarding game for Android built in Godot 4.x with GDScript. This is a large build request. Let me plan the architecture:

- project.godot (Godot 4.x, Mobile/Compatibility renderer)
- Main scene with park (~600x600m playable): central plaza, street area, bowl, empty pool, stairs, rails, benches, ramps, small tunnel, return routes
- Player controller with analog controls (virtual joystick for touch + keyboard fallback)
- Mechanics: ollie, flip tricks, grinds, manuals, bails/falls, gaps, score
- Quality profiles: Low/Medium/High
- HUD with score, trick name popups, combo

Let me check the workspace first.

I should build a complete Godot project structure. I can't run Godot to test, but I can write the files. Maybe Godot is available? Let me check the environment. Probably not. I'll write careful GDScript code.

Let me design:

```
skate3d/
  project.godot
  README.md
  export_presets.cfg (maybe skip; android config needed locally)
  scenes/
    main.tscn
    player.tscn
    hud.tscn
  scripts/
    game.gd (autoload GameManager? score, settings)
    player.gd
    trick_system.gd
    hud.gd
    touch_controls.gd
    quality.gd (autoload settings)
  ... maybe generate park procedurally in code to avoid huge .tscn files — build the park from GDScript using CSG/CollisionShape primitives. That's smart: park_builder.gd generating the map at runtime. Reduces scene file complexity and makes modularity (quality low removes props) easy.
```

Approach: Minimal .tscn files; most content generated by scripts. Player as CharacterBody3D with custom skate physics:

- Ground movement: push acceleration, friction, steering (board yaw)
- Ollie: jump impulse along up + forward
- Tricks: kickflip/heelflip/shuvit variants via button combos; trick animation = rotate a board mesh node; landing checks rotation completion
- Grinds: detect rails (Area3D with metadata "rail"), snap when airborne and descending near rail top, lock position along rail axis, balance meter maybe simplified
- Manuals: hold button to manual, balance meter
- Bail: landing sideways/unfinished flip too long, or hitting wall at speed → bail state, respawn
- Gaps: Area3D zones with names; scoring bonus when jumping across
- Score: base points * multiplier, combo continues until bail or landing clean pause

Physics on CharacterBody3D with custom gravity, slope handling via raycasts to align board to ground normal.

Touch controls: left virtual stick (steer + push), right buttons (ollie, trick, grind/manual). Also keyboard for desktop testing.

Quality profiles: adjust shadow, MSAA, props visibility, particle count. A settings screen at start with Low/Med/High buttons.

Park builder: use CSG or MeshInstance3D with BoxMesh/PlaneMesh + StaticBody3D collision shapes. Use simple concrete colors. Props (decor) in "Props" group removed on Low.

Map layout 600x600 (coordinates -300..300):
- Central plaza at origin: flat, benches, rails, ledges, fountain (skateable ledge ring?)
- Street area east: curbs, handrails, stairs with rail, ledges
- Bowl west: rounded bowl (approximated with cylinder segments or use a CSG — simpler: use a sphere-ish concave via CSGCombiner? Simpler: build bowl from a cylinder of boxes? Actually a bowl can be approximated with a truncated cone mesh using ConcavePolygonShape from mesh create_trimesh_shape — inverted. Simplest robust: build bowl walls as angled box segments in a ring, and pool similar smaller with rounded corners approximated by angled segments.
- Small tunnel: arch made of boxes; just make a tunnel through a hill between areas.
- Return routes: perimeter paths connecting areas.

Scoring gaps: define gap areas e.g., "Fountain Gap", "Stair Set", "Tunnel Run".

HUD: score top-right, combo multiplier, trick popups, speedometer maybe, balance bar for manual/grind.

I need to be careful with GDScript 4 syntax. Write clean code.

Also screenshots for my own checks: I can't run Godot headless... unless installed. Let me check `which godot`. If available (unlikely), I could render screenshots. Check first.

Given effort constraints, I'll aim for a solid, complete single-file-heavy implementation:

Files:
- project.godot — config: window, input map, autoloads, renderer mobile, android settings section (xr? no). Include display/window stretch for mobile.
- scripts/settings.gd (autoload): quality profile, save/load.
- scripts/game.gd (autoload): score, combo, events, trick popups via signals.
- scenes/main.tscn: root Node3D with script main.gd, plus WorldEnvironment + DirectionalLight3D; camera rig attached to player.
- scripts/main.gd: builds park (calls park_builder), spawns player, handles settings menu.
- scripts/park_builder.gd: builds everything.
- scenes/player.tscn or create player fully in code. Player in code: player.gd extends CharacterBody3D, builds board mesh children.
- scripts/hud.gd + built in code (CanvasLayer with Labels, buttons, virtual stick).
- scripts/touch_controls.gd.

Player physics details:
- gravity ~ -22
- push: input y on stick → accelerate in facing direction up to max speed; also "pump" in transitions (when on transition, holding input adds speed).
- steering: input x rotates yaw proportional to speed.
- friction: rolling resistance small; air drag small.
- ollie: press ollie button → crouch charge briefly; release → jump. Simplify: press = jump with impulse; hold longer = higher (charge while pressed up to 0.4s, release triggers). For simplicity: tap jumps immediately with fixed impulse; holding before pressing? Let's do charge-then-release but also auto-release at max.
- Tricks in air: trick button + stick direction combos: flip (kickflip), direction up = heelflip? Standard: right stick flick. I'll map: trick button + direction on left stick: up=heelflip? Let's define: no direction = ollie-style/Pop Shove-it? Simpler scheme: trick button with stick direction at moment of press:
  - none: Pop Shove-it (yaw spin 180? no—shove-it is board yaw 180) 
  - left/right: Kickflip
  - up: Heelflip
  - down: Impossible? Use "360 Shove-it".
  - Also grab button? Keep: grind button doubles as manual on ground.
- Rotation animation: board mesh child "Board" rotates around axis; must complete ~80% before landing or bail (sketchy landing = reduced points).
- Spins: body yaw from steering in air spins; landing counter-rotates or allows fakie.
- Grind: when airborne and a RailArea nearby (Area3D with script metadata), snap: position on rail, velocity along rail axis preserving speed; grind until reach end (rail has start/end points) or press ollie to jump off; balance meter: stick x must counter drift.
- Manual: on ground hold grind/manual button: pitch board up, balance meter with stick y.
- Bail: if land while board rotated too much (angle > ~35° off velocity direction), or grind balance exceeds, or high speed wall hit → bail: 1.5s ragdoll-ish (just play fall, score lost, combo reset), respawn at last safe position.
- Landing clean: points added, multiplier +.

Scoring numbers: tricks base 100-500, grind 50 per second-ish, manual similar, gaps +500.

Trick names popup with points.

Camera: third-person follow with smoothing, look-ahead, slight FOV increase with speed. Also manual camera orbit? Skip orbit; keep simple follow.

Environment: sky procedural, sun with shadows per quality, fog subtle, park ground texture via simple colors — use a checker/grid? Use plain colors + AO-ish vertex colors. Keep simple: flat colored meshes with slight variation, no textures. Add simple "noise" via multimesh scattered props on High/Med.

GridMaterial? Not needed.

Sound: skip (no assets). Could add WebAudio gen? Skip; note as assumption.

project.godot input map: keyboard keys for desktop testing: arrows/WASD, space=ollie, J=trick, K=grind/manual, R=respawn.

Autoloads: Settings (settings.gd), Game (game.gd).

Renderer: mobile. Shadows: directional shadow enabled per quality. MSAA via viewport per quality.

Android export: include export_presets.cfg template? It needs keystore etc. I can provide a basic export_presets.cfg for Android with placeholders and instructions in README. That's helpful.

Let me also decide structure of main.tscn minimal: root "Main" (Node3D, script main.gd). Everything else built in _ready(). WorldEnvironment built in code too (per-quality). That keeps .tscn tiny.

HUD: CanvasLayer built in code in hud.gd.

Let me write the code carefully.

Key GDScript 4 pitfalls:
- `move_and_slide()` no args; use `velocity`.
- Floor detection: `is_on_floor()`, but with custom gravity & slopes, use up_direction default Vector3.UP.
- For skate transitions (quarter pipes), sliding along slopes: set floor_max_angle high (like 60°+) so ramps are floor. Snap: floor_snap_length.
- Aligning board to floor normal: use floor normal from `get_floor_normal()`.

Player rig structure (built in code):
- Player (CharacterBody3D, script player.gd)
  - BoardRig (Node3D) — rotated to floor normal & yaw
    - Deck (MeshInstance3D box thin) + trucks/wheels (small boxes/cylinders) + CharacterDummy (simple capsule person?) Keep a simple skater made of boxes/capsules: body capsule + head sphere. Cute low-poly.

Board rotation for tricks on child "TrickNode".

Grind rails: create as StaticBody3D thin box with top surface? Grind detection: I'll implement rails as Area3D with a `Rail` script storing start/end points. Player when airborne checks overlapping areas in group "rail", picks closest, projects.

Collision layers:
1: world (static)
2: player
3: rails (areas)
Player collision mask: world. Rail areas monitor player? Areas detect bodies; set area monitoring, mask=2.

Grind implementation details: on snap, store rail axis (end-start normalized), position = closest point on segment, progress; velocity = axis * speed sign. Each physics frame: move along axis at speed; check still over rail (segment end → pop off with small hop); balance: drift = sin(t)*random + input; player must counter with stick; if |drift|>1 → bail.

Manual: similar balance using stick y; manual requires speed > threshold; ends when button released or balance fails.

Landing detection for tricks: track trick rotation progress; when landing (is_on_floor transition), if trick active and progress < 0.8 → bail chance / actually: if progress < 0.75 bail; 0.75-0.95 sketchy (half points); else clean.

Also velocity direction vs board yaw misalignment at landing > 40° → bail (or auto-correct to fakie if within 140-180 → ride switch). Keep simpler: if angle > 50°, bail; if between 130 and 180, switch (fakie) ok with multiplier bonus.

Gaps: Area3D zones; when player leaves gap A airborne and lands beyond... simpler: gap area between two markers; award when player jumps from inside start zone and lands in end zone without touching ground between. Implement: gap zones as Area3D "gap"; on entering gap zone while airborne → mark pending; on landing while pending and left a takeoff zone → award. Simplify: single Area3D covering the gap air volume: award when player passes through while airborne (entered and exited airborne). Good enough: "Tunnel Run", "Fountain Gap", "Stairs Gap", "Bowl Spine" etc.

Trick system scoring in game.gd autoload with signals: `trick_named(name, points)`, `score_changed`, `combo_changed`, `bail`.

HUD shows: score, combo, popup list of recent tricks, balance bar, speed.

Settings menu at start: quality Low/Medium/High + Start button; also accessible via pause.

Quality application:
- Low: no shadows, MSAA off, props hidden, fewer particles, fog off, lower pixel? keep.
- Medium: shadows on (2048), MSAA 2x, props on, fog on.
- High: shadows 4096, MSAA 4x, props on + extra, fog on, SSAO? maybe skip for mobile. Add slight environment tweaks.

Props group: all decorative meshes added to group "prop" → toggling visibility.

Park builder: helper functions:
- `box(size, pos, rot, color, collide=true, group="")`
- Use one StaticBody3D per piece with BoxMesh + CollisionShape3D. That's many nodes but fine.

For ramps (quarter pipes): use angled boxes; also use `PrismMesh` for wedges? For a quarter pipe curve, approximate with several angled segments. I'll write `quarter_pipe()` generating curved wall from ~6 segments (boxes rotated). Collision via box shapes rotated — fine with trimesh? Rotated box shapes are OK.

Bowl: ring of angled segments at varying heights, e.g., 8 segments per quarter... Actually a bowl: circular. Build with N=16 segments around circle, each segment a box rotated to be tangent, inclined. Pool: rounded rect bowl smaller, similar with corners. Coping: thin cylinders at rim (decor).

Stairs: N steps boxes. Handrail: cylinder along side + rail area.

Tunnel: hill = big box mound with arched passage: build two side walls + top slab; through-passage. Gap zone inside.

Perimeter: ground plane 600x600 with border walls low (or just fence boxes) and paths.

Also add some trees/props for high quality (decor group).

Let me now think about code size. This is big but doable. Write files:

1. project.godot
2. scripts/settings.gd (autoload "Settings")
3. scripts/game.gd (autoload "Game")
4. scripts/main.gd
5. scripts/park_builder.gd
6. scripts/player.gd
7. scripts/hud.gd
8. scenes/main.tscn
9. README.md
10. export_presets.cfg (Android preset skeleton)

Input map in project.godot: define actions:
- steer_left/right/up/down? Virtual stick supplies analog via code (axis values directly). For keyboard: "push" (W/Up), "brake"(S), steer with A/D.
- ollie (Space), trick (J), grind (K/K? use LShift?), respawn (R), pause (Esc).

I'll define input actions in project.godot [input] section.

Touch UI: left half = virtual joystick (steer x, push y), right side buttons: OLLIE (big), TRICK, GRIND/MANUAL. Draw with simple Control nodes (Panel/ColorRect + Labels). Implement touch_controls.gd handling multi-touch via _input and _gui_input... Multi-touch with Control nodes: each button is a Control with _gui_input handling press/release; joystick custom control. Godot handles multi-touch with `emulate_mouse_from_touch` off; Controls get touch via InputEventScreenTouch. I'll implement joystick & buttons as Controls processing InputEventScreenTouch/Drag with index tracking. Simpler: handle all touch at HUD level: any touch starting on left half → joystick; touches on button rects → buttons. I'll write a single TouchLayer Control covering screen handling InputEventScreenTouch/Drag, mapping to states, drawing indicators with ColorRects/Labels positioned. Use `_draw`? Use child ColorRects for visuals updated per frame. Keep visuals simple: circles via ColorRect? Not round... Use a simple StyleBox? Controls with rounded corners need StyleBoxFlat with corner radius — doable via theme overrides in code: Panel with StyleBoxFlat corner_radius. Fine.

Actually to keep HUD code manageable, I'll create round-ish visuals with StyleBoxFlat (corner radius = half size) on Panel nodes. Good.

Analog input values: player reads from Input.get_axis etc. for keyboard, and touch layer writes to a shared object (TouchState autoload? or HUD exposes). I'll put touch state in the HUD and player gets reference via main. Or make autoload "InputHub" that merges keyboard and touch: `steer: Vector2`, `push: float`, buttons pressed events queued. Player polls InputHub. Buttons edge detection: InputHub provides `just_pressed(name)` consuming flags.

Let me define InputHub as autoload scripts/input_hub.gd:
- `stick: Vector2` (touch), keyboard adds.
- `buttons: Dictionary` pressed states; `pressed_edges: Dictionary` consumed.
- API: `get_steer()`, `push_amount()`, `down(name)`, `just(name)`.
- Keyboard handled in _process polling Input.is_action_pressed + edge tracking.

Player uses InputHub exclusively. Clean.

Camera: in main.gd or player? Attach camera logic to player script with a Camera3D node child created in code? Camera as sibling better; simplest: Camera3D child of Main, script camera_rig? I'll do: player.gd creates and manages its own Camera3D added to parent (avoid child so it doesn't inherit rotation). Player handles camera follow in _physics_process. Fine.

Now the trick/bail/grind logic — write carefully.

Player states enum: NORMAL, AIR, GRIND, MANUAL, BAIL, CROUCH(implicit via timer).

Board mesh & skater dummy: simple:
- Deck: BoxMesh 0.85 x 0.03 x 0.22 (board along +Z forward).
- Wheels: 4 small cylinders.
- Skater: capsule body, sphere head, arms as boxes; legs static (no IK). Position feet on board approx.

BoardRig orientation: yaw = facing; align to floor normal with quaternion from UP to normal; tricks rotate TrickNode (child of BoardRig, containing deck+wheels? skater stays on BoardRig but not TrickNode—skater on BoardRig only).

Trick animation in air: rotate TrickNode around local axis with progress. Shove-it: yaw 180 over 0.35s. Kickflip: roll 360 over 0.4s. Heelflip: roll -360. 360 shove: yaw 360 over 0.5s. Track progress 0..1; when landing, snap TrickNode rotation to zero (completed) or bail.

Air spins: allow body yaw spin with flick? Add "spin" by holding steer left/right in air → yaw spin; landing switch/fakie handled. Fine.

Speed & push:
- max_speed base 12 m/s; pushing adds accel 6 m/s² while push held & on floor & speed<max.
- steering: yaw_rate = steer.x * (2.2 rad/s scaled down at high speed: rate = lerp(2.5, 1.0, speed/max)).
- friction: velocity decays 0.5/s rolling; brake (push negative / S) stronger 4/s.
- When airborne: keep horizontal velocity, slight air drag; gravity 22 (a bit floaty 18?). Ollie impulse: base 7.5 + charge up to 11.

Transition pumping: when on slope with normal tilted (floor normal.y < 0.95), holding push adds extra accel along downhill→uphill? Simplify: pumping = press push at bottom... skip complexity: on ramps, gravity component along slope naturally gives speed; add "pump bonus": while on transition and push held, add accel 4 along velocity direction. OK.

Wall hit bail: after move_and_slide, check `get_slide_collision_count()`; if collision normal.y < 0.4 and speed before > 8 → bail. Else just kill velocity into wall (move_and_slide handles).

Respawn: track last grounded safe pos every 0.5s; on bail finish or fall below y<-5, teleport there with small velocity.

Grind details:
- Rails list stored in park (group "rail", each Area3D with script rail_area.gd? Or store metadata: use a small class RailData with points). I'll create rails as Area3D with meta "rail_start"/"rail_end" or custom script rail.gd extends Area3D with `begin, end` exported. Simpler: park_builder sets meta.
- Player when airborne: get overlapping areas (area.get_overlapping_areas? player Area3D detection: player needs an Area3D child or use area monitoring body. Player is CharacterBody3D (PhysicsBody3D) — Area3D can detect bodies. From player side: keep list via area body_entered signals → but those signals go to the area's script. Rail script can push player: on body_entered → if body has method `on_rail_near` call it with self. Simplest: rail.gd (Area3D) with body_entered connecting to player.grind_candidate(self) — but area only triggers on overlap; grind snap wants proximity ~1m. Make rail Area box slightly larger (0.5 wide, 1.5 tall above rail). Good.
- On candidate while airborne & velocity.y < 2 & not just left grind (cooldown): snap if angle between velocity and rail axis < 60° (either direction). Set state GRIND, position on line at height of rail top + board offset, velocity = axis * (speed * sign).
- During grind: move along; sparks particle? skip or simple CPUParticles3D at contact. Add small particle burst — CPUParticles3D one-shot on snap. Optional; include lightweight.
- Balance: drift value; drift_rate changes randomly; steer input reduces in opposite; |drift|>=1 → bail. Balance bar shown on HUD.
- End: when progress beyond segment → pop off: small up impulse, state AIR.
- Ollie during grind: jump off with points per time accumulated.

Score: game.gd add_trick(name, base) → pending score accumulates in combo; landing clean commits pending with multiplier; bail loses pending. Multiplier increases by 1 per trick landed (cap 20?). Combo timer: after landing clean, combo continues while doing another trick within 3s / or ends when idle 2s without trick. Standard: combo persists across tricks until bail. Keep: combo ends on bail or after 4s without new trick (then bank).

HUD:
- Top-left: score big, combo "x3" below with pending points "+450".
- Center-bottom: trick name popup fading.
- Balance bar center-bottom when grinding/manual.
- Speed small.
- Settings button top-right (pause menu: resume, quality select, restart).

Pause: main handles Esc → pause menu CanvasLayer with buttons; get_tree().paused; player process_mode paused exempt? Set Main process_mode PAUSABLE default; menu PAUSE_MODE... process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS for menu.

Main scene flow: boot → settings overlay (quality buttons + start) → play. Build park at _ready regardless.

main.tscn: root Node3D "Main" script main.gd. All else code.

Environment per quality:
- Environment: background sky (ProceduralSkyMaterial), ambient from sky, fog, glow subtle on high.
- DirectionalLight3D rotated (-50° pitch, 30 yaw), shadow settings per quality.

Materials: create a few shared StandardMaterial3D: concrete gray light, concrete dark, coping metal, rail metal, wood, grass green, wall colors. park_builder holds refs.

Ground: big box 600x600x1 top at y=0, color asphalt-ish light gray; separate area patches colored differently (plaza tiles lighter, street darker with lane stripes decor? skip stripes or simple white boxes as stripes - decor).

Bowl geometry: center at (-160, 0, 0)? Layout plan (x east, z south):
- Playable: -300..300 both axes, border fence at ±300.
- Plaza: center (0,0) radius ~60: flat, fountain ring ledge at (0,0), benches, rails.
- Street: east x in 120..280: stair set with handrail, ledges, curbs, kicker.
- Bowl: west centered (-170, 0, 60) radius 40 depth -4: bowl segments.
- Pool: north (-120, -160?) Let's use z south positive... positions arbitrary. Pool at (-160, -120) (northwest): kidney-ish rect bowl smaller depth -2.5.
- Tunnel: hill between plaza and street-north at (80, -120): mound 40x30 height 8 with tunnel through.
- Ramps/quarter: along west edge of street area; a big quarter pipe facing plaza at x=90? 
- Perimeter path connects all: flat ring at edges.

I'll just place elements with reasonable coordinates; exactness doesn't matter as long as it's coherent.

Rail list: plaza rails 2, street handrail (long, on stairs), ledge rails maybe as ledge grinds too (ledge = box; grinds on ledge top edge? treat ledges also as rails along top edges? Could add rail areas on ledge edges—yes add thin rail areas atop ledges for grind feel).

Gaps: fountain gap (area over fountain ring gap), stair gap over stairs, tunnel run (through tunnel while airborne not touching ground? tunnel ground flat so gap = over a kicker-to-landing inside? Make tunnel with a bump ramp inside; gap zone over the bump), bowl spine? skip.

OK, also "quedas" (falls) done; "manuals" done; "gaps" done; "grinds" done; "manobras" done; "controle analógico" — virtual stick + keyboard.

Input action format in project.godot:

```
[input]
ollie={
"deadzone": 0.2,

```
Writing InputEventKey serialization is verbose but standard; I must be careful with exact syntax. That avoids serialization pitfalls entirely. 

Now write player.gd thoroughly. Let me draft mentally key parts.

```gdscript
extends CharacterBody3D

const GRAVITY := 22.0
const MAX_SPEED := 13.0
const PUSH_ACCEL := 7.0
const ROLL_FRICTION := 0.35
const BRAKE_DECEL := 8.0
const STEER_MAX := 2.4

enum State { GROUND, AIR, GRIND, MANUAL, BAIL }

var state: State = State.GROUND
var facing := 0.0  # yaw radians
var charge := 0.0
var charge_held := false
var trick: Dictionary = {}  # {name, axis: Vector3(local), spin: float, time, dur, base}
var air_time := 0.0
var grind_rail: Node = null
var grind_t := 0.0
var grind_sign := 1.0
var grind_drift := 0.0
var grind_points := 0.0
var manual_time := 0.0
var manual_drift := 0.0
var bail_timer := 0.0
var safe_pos := Vector3.ZERO
var switch_stance := false
var last_ground_pos...
```

Movement on ground:
```
func _ground_move(delta):
    var fwd = Basis(Vector3.UP, facing) * Vector3(0,0,-1)? 
```
Convention: forward = -Z (Godot camera forward). Board model built with nose toward -Z? Let's define forward = -Z to match Godot convention; basis rows: I'll compute `var f := -transform.basis.z` no—BoardRig handles visual; physics velocity independent of transform since I set transform manually. Keep `facing` yaw; forward vector = Vector3(-sin(facing), 0, -cos(facing))? For yaw rotation about Y: Basis(UP, facing) applied to (0,0,-1) = (-sin f, 0, -cos f). Yes.

velocity horizontal steering: rotate velocity direction toward facing? Skateboard carves: velocity follows board direction gradually. Implement: 
```
var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
var speed := flat.length()
var target := forward * speed
var control := 0.9 (ground) 
flat = flat.lerp(target, clamp(delta * 6.0 * grip,0,1)) # grip lower when sliding? keep constant
```
This makes carving. Plus lateral friction kills drift. Fine.

Push:

extends Node
## Game (autoload): pontuação, combos, popups de manobra.

signal score_changed(score: int, pending: int, mult: int)
signal trick_popup(text: String, points: int)
signal combo_ended(total: int, mult: int)

const COMBO_WINDOW := 4.0
const MAX_MULT := 20

var score := 0
var pending := 0
var mult := 0
var best_combo := 0
var combo_timer := 0.0


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if pending > 0:
		combo_timer -= delta
		if combo_timer <= 0.0:
			bank()


func reset() -> void:
	score = 0
	pending = 0
	mult = 0
	best_combo = 0
	combo_timer = 0.0
	score_changed.emit(score, pending, mult)


## Registra uma manobra (nome já formatado) valendo `pts` na combo atual.
func add_trick(text: String, pts: int) -> void:
	if pts <= 0:
		return
	pending += pts
	mult = mini(mult + 1, MAX_MULT)
	combo_timer = COMBO_WINDOW
	trick_popup.emit(text, pts)
	score_changed.emit(score, pending, mult)


## Mantém a combo viva durante grinds/manuals.
func extend_combo() -> void:
	if pending > 0:
		combo_timer = COMBO_WINDOW


## Fecha a combo: soma pendente * multiplicador no placar.
func bank() -> void:
	if pending <= 0:
		return
	var total := pending * maxi(mult, 1)
	score += total
	best_combo = maxi(best_combo, total)
	trick_popup.emit("Combo x%d  +%d" % [maxi(mult, 1), total], total)
	pending = 0
	mult = 0
	combo_timer = 0.0
	combo_ended.emit(total, 0)
	score_changed.emit(score, pending, mult)


## Queda: perde tudo que estava na combo.
func bail() -> void:
	pending = 0
	mult = 0
	combo_timer = 0.0
	trick_popup.emit("Queda!", 0)
	score_changed.emit(score, pending, mult)


func gap(gap_name: String) -> void:
	add_trick("GAP %s" % gap_name, 500)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:

		S.AIR:

		S.GRIND:

		S.MANUAL:

		S.BAIL:

func _ground(delta: float) -> void:
	var speed_before := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z).length()
	var fwd := _forward()
	var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
	var speed := flat.length()

	# direção / carving
	var steer := InputHub.get_steer()
	facing -= steer * _steer_rate(speed) * delta

	# empurrar / frear / bomba nas transições
	var p := InputHub.get_push()
	if p > 0.05 and speed < MAX_SPEED:
		flat += fwd * PUSH_ACCEL * p * delta
		if _on_transition():
			flat += flat.normalized() * PUMP_ACCEL * delta
	elif p < -0.05:

	flat = flat.lerp(fwd * speed, minf(1.0, CARVE_GRIP * delta))

	velocity.z = flat.z
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

		if not InputHub.down("ollie") or charge >= MAX_CHARGE:

			return

	# manual

	if safe_timer <= 0.0 and Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z).length() > 1.0:
		safe_pos = global_position
		safe_timer = 0.8


func _ollie(power: float) -> void:
	velocity.y = lerpf(JUMP_MIN, JUMP_MAX, power) + maxf(0.0, Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z).length() * 0.08)
	state = S.AIR
	air_time = 0.0
	spin_accum = 0.0
	Game.add_trick("Ollie", 10)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ AR

func _air(delta: float) -> void:
	air_time += delta
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

	# spin corporal no ar
	var steer := InputHub.get_steer()
	facing += steer * 3.6 * delta
	spin_accum += steer * 3.6 * delta

	# manobra de flip/shove
	if trick_name.is_empty() and InputHub.just("trick"):
		_start_trick()
	if not trick_name.is_empty():
		_tick_trick(delta)

	# procura corrimão para grind
	if velocity.y < 1.5 and grind_cooldown <= 0.0:
		_try_grind_snap()
		if state == S.GRIND:
			return

	move_and_slide()
	if is_on_floor():
		_land()


func _start_trick() -> void:
	var dir := InputHub.stick
	var key := "shuvit"
	if dir.length() >= 0.4:
		if absf(dir.x) >= absf(dir.y):
			key = "kickflip" if dir.x < 0.0 else "heelflip"
		else:
			key = "heelflip" if dir.y > 0.0 else "shovit360"
	var t: Dictionary = TRICKS[key]
	trick_name = t.n
	trick_axis = t.axis
	trick_spins = t.spins
	trick_dur = t.dur
	trick_time = 0.0
	trick_pts = t.pts
	trick_awarded = false


func _tick_trick(delta: float) -> void:
	trick_time += delta
	var pr := clampf(trick_time / trick_dur, 0.0, 1.0)
	trick_node.rotation = trick_axis * (trick_spins * TAU * pr)
	if pr >= 1.0:
		Game.add_trick(trick_name, trick_pts)
		trick_awarded = true
		trick_name = ""
		trick_time = 0.0
		trick_node.rotation = Vector3.ZERO


func _land() -> void:
	# alinhamento do shape com a velocidade
	var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
	if flat.length() > 0.5:
		var vd := flat.normalized()
		var v_yaw := atan2(-vd.x, -vd.z)
		var err := wrapf(facing - v_yaw, -PI, PI)
		if absf(err) > PI / 2.0:
			_bail_start()
			return
		facing = v_yaw

	# flip incompleto na aterrissagem
	if not trick_name.is_empty():
		var pr := trick_time / trick_dur
		trick_node.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
		if pr < 0.75:
			_bail_start()
			return
		Game.add_trick(trick_name + " (vacilado)", int(trick_pts * 0.4))
		trick_name = ""

	# bônus de spin
	var spins := int(floor((absf(spin_accum) + 0.6) / PI))
	if spins >= 1:
		var names := ["", "180", "360", "540", "720", "900"]
		var nm := names[mini(spins, 5)] + " Spin"
		Game.add_trick(nm, spins * 100)

	trick_awarded = false
	state = S.GROUND
	_mark_safe(0.0)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ GRIND

func _try_grind_snap() -> void:
	var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
	var speed := flat.length()
	if speed < 3.0:
		return
	var best: Area3D = null
	var best_t := 0.0
	var best_d := 1e9
	var best_ab := Vector3.ZERO
	for a in sensor.get_overlapping_areas():
		if not a.is_in_group("rail"):
			continue
		var pa: Vector3 = a.get_meta("a")
		var pb: Vector3 = a.get_meta("b")
		var ab := pb - pa
		var l := ab.length()
		if l < 0.3:
			continue
		var d := ab / l
		var t := clampf((global_position - pa).dot(d), 0.0, l)
		var p := pa + d * t
		var dy := global_position.y - p.y
		if absf(dy) > 1.1:
			continue
		var dxz := Vector2(global_position.x - p.x, global_position.z - p.z).length()
		if dxz > 0.95:
			continue
		if absf(flat.normalized().dot(d)) < 0.5:
			continue
		var score := dxz + absf(dy) * 2.0
		if score < best_d:
			best_d = score
			best = a
			best_t = t
			best_ab = ab
	if best == null:
		return

	rail = best
	rail_a = best.get_meta("a")
	rail_ab = best_ab
	rail_len = best_ab.length()
	rail_t = best_t
	var d := rail_ab / rail_len
	grind_sign = signf(velocity.x * d.x + velocity.y * d.y + velocity.z * d.z)
	if grind_sign == 0.0:
		grind_sign = 1.0
	var spd := maxf(velocity.dot(d) * grind_sign, 4.0)
	velocity = d * grind_sign * spd
	velocity.y = maxf(velocity.y, -1.0)
	global_position = rail_a + d * best_t
	state = S.GRIND
	grind_drift = 0.0
	grind_pts = 0.0
	grind_wander = 1.0 if randf() > 0.5 else -1.0
	wander_timer = randf_range(0.5, 1.1)
	Game.extend_combo()
	sparks.global_position = global_position
	sparks.restart()
	sparks.emitting = true


func _grind(delta: float) -> void:
	var d := rail_ab / rail_len
	var spd := velocity.dot(d) * grind_sign
	spd = maxf(spd - 0.6 * delta, 3.0)
	velocity = d * grind_sign * spd
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * 0.35 * delta

	rail_t += spd * delta
	grind_pts += 80.0 * delta

	# equilíbrio
	wander_timer -= delta
	if wander_timer <= 0.0:
		grind_wander = -grind_wander
		wander_timer = randf_range(0.5, 1.1)
	grind_drift += (grind_wander * 0.55 - InputHub.get_steer() * 1.5) * delta
	if absf(grind_drift) >= 1.0:
		_bail_start()
		return

	Game.extend_combo()

	if InputHub.just("ollie"):
		_grind_end(5.0)
		return
	if rail_t >= rail_len or rail_t <= 0.0:
		_grind_end(1.5)
		return

	move_and_slide()


func _grind_end(hop: float) -> void:
	Game.add_trick("50-50 Grind", int(grind_pts))
	grind_cooldown = 0.35
	rail = null
	state = S.AIR
	air_time = 0.0
	spin_accum = 0.0
	velocity += Vector3.UP * hop


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ MANUAL

func _start_manual() -> void:
	state = S.MANUAL
	manual_drift = 0.0
	manual_pts = 0.0
	manual_wander = 1.0 if randf() > 0.5 else -1.0
	wander_timer = randf_range(0.5, 1.0)
	Game.add_trick("Manual", 50)


func _manual(delta: float) -> void:
	var fwd := _forward()
	var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
	var speed := flat.length()

	# quase sem direção durante o manual
	var steer := InputHub.get_steer()
	facing -= steer * _steer_rate(speed) * 0.3 * delta
	flat = flat.lerp(fwd * speed, minf(1.0, 4.0 * delta))
	velocity.x = flat.x
	velocity.z = flat.z
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta

	manual_pts += 60.0 * delta
	wander_timer -= delta
	if wander_timer <= 0.0:
		manual_wander = -manual_wander
		wander_timer = randf_range(0.5, 1.0)
	manual_drift += (manual_wander * 0.5 - InputHub.get_push() * 1.4) * delta
	if absf(manual_drift) >= 1.0:
		_bail_start()
		return

	Game.extend_combo()

	if not InputHub.down("grind") or speed < 2.0:
		Game.add_trick("Manual", int(manual_pts))
		state = S.GROUND
		return

	move_and_slide()
	if not is_on_floor():
		Game.add_trick("Manual", int(manual_pts))
		state = S.AIR
		air_time = 0.0
		spin_accum = 0.0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ QUEDA

func _bail_start() -> void:
	Game.bail()
	state = S.BAIL
	bail_t = BAIL_TIME
	velocity *= 0.25
	trick_name = ""
	trick_node.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	rail = null
	Game.set_meta("balance_off", true)


func _bail(delta: float) -> void:
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0.0, 6.0 * delta)
	velocity.z = move_toward(velocity.z, 0.0, 6.0 * delta)
	velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	skater.rotation.x += 7.0 * delta
	skater.rotation.z += 4.0 * delta
	move_and_slide()
	bail_t -= delta
	if bail_t <= 0.0 or global_position.y < -10.0:
		_teleport_safe()


func _teleport_safe() -> void:
	global_position = safe_pos + Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)
	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	skater.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	safe_timer = 0.0
	state = S.GROUND


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ VISUAL / CÂMERA

func _update_rig(delta: float) -> void:
	var yaw := Basis(Vector3.UP, facing)
	if (state == S.GROUND or state == S.MANUAL) and is_on_floor():
		var n := get_floor_normal()
		var q := Quaternion(Vector3.UP, n)
		rig.global_basis = Basis(q) * yaw
		if state == S.MANUAL:
			rig.rotate_object_local(Vector3(1, 0, 0), -0.22)
	else:
		rig.global_basis = yaw


func _update_camera(delta: float) -> void:
	var flat := Vector3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z)
	var fwd := _forward()
	if flat.length() > 2.0 and state != S.BAIL:
		fwd = fwd.lerp(flat.normalized(), 0.6).normalized()
	cam_last_fwd = cam_last_fwd.lerp(fwd, minf(1.0, 5.0 * delta))
	var target := global_position + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0)
	var speed := flat.length()
	var dist := 5.0 + speed * 0.07
	var desired := target - cam_last_fwd * dist + Vector3(0, 1.7, 0)

	# evita atravessar paredes
	var space := get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(target, desired, 1)
	var hit := space.intersect_ray(query)
	if hit.has("position"):
		desired = hit.position - cam_last_fwd * 0.3 + Vector3(0, 0.2, 0)

	cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(desired, minf(1.0, 7.0 * delta))
	cam.look_at(target + cam_last_fwd * 2.0, Vector3.UP)
	cam.fov = clampf(64.0 + speed * 0.9, 64.0, 84.0)

extends Node3D
## ParkBuilder: constrói o parque Aurora (600 x 600 m) por código.
## Tudo é modular: elementos decorativos ficam em "props" e podem ser
## desligados no perfil Baixo sem alterar as linhas de skate.

var props: Node3D  # decorativos (visibilidade por qualidade)

var m_asphalt: StandardMaterial3D
var m_concrete: StandardMaterial3D
var m_concrete2: StandardMaterial3D
var m_red: StandardMaterial3D
var m_metal: StandardMaterial3D
var m_wood: StandardMaterial3D
var m_grass: StandardMaterial3D
var m_trunk: StandardMaterial3D
var m_leaf: StandardMaterial3D
var m_dark: StandardMaterial3D
var m_water: StandardMaterial3D


func build() -> void:
	_make_materials()
	props = Node3D.new()
	props.name = "Props"
	add_child(props)

	_ground()
	_plaza()
	_street()
	_bowl()
	_pool()
	_tunnel()
	_quarter(Vector3(-70, 0, 0), 90.0, 4.5, 0.0)   # de frente para a praça (leste)
	_quarter(Vector3(0, 0, 78), 60.0, 4.2, -PI / 2)  # sul, de frente para o norte
	_fences()
	_props_decor()


func _make_materials() -> void:
	m_asphalt = _mat(Color(0.42, 0.42, 0.44), 0.0, 0.95)
	m_concrete = _mat(Color(0.62, 0.61, 0.58), 0.0, 0.9)
	m_concrete2 = _mat(Color(0.53, 0.52, 0.5), 0.0, 0.9)
	m_red = _mat(Color(0.65, 0.2, 0.16), 0.0, 0.85)
	m_metal = _mat(Color(0.78, 0.78, 0.8), 0.95, 0.3)
	m_wood = _mat(Color(0.55, 0.38, 0.22), 0.0, 0.85)
	m_grass = _mat(Color(0.3, 0.5, 0.25), 0.0, 1.0)
	m_trunk = _mat(Color(0.35, 0.26, 0.18), 0.0, 1.0)
	m_leaf = _mat(Color(0.22, 0.45, 0.2), 0.0, 1.0)
	m_dark = _mat(Color(0.25, 0.25, 0.27), 0.0, 0.9)
	m_water = _mat(Color(0.2, 0.45, 0.55), 0.1, 0.3)


func _mat(c: Color, metal := 0.0, rough := 0.9) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = c
	m.metallic = metal
	m.roughness = rough
	return m


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ básicos

## Caixa sólida com colisão.
func _box(size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, mat: StandardMaterial3D, yaw := 0.0, pitch := 0.0) -> StaticBody3D:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.collision_layer = 1
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = size
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.material_override = mat
	body.add_child(mi)
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = size
	cs.shape = shape
	body.add_child(cs)
	body.position = pos
	body.rotation = Vector3(pitch, yaw, 0)
	add_child(body)
	return body


## Mesh sem colisão (uso decorativo/estrutural fino).
func _mesh_box(size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, mat: StandardMaterial3D, basis: Basis) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = size
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.position = pos
	mi.global_basis = basis  # rotaciona em espaço mundial
	add_child(mi)
	return mi


## Laje inclinada entre dois pontos A->B, extrudada ao longo de `wdir`
## com meia-largura `hw` para cada lado. A superfície superior passa por A e B.
func _slab(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, wdir: Vector3, hw: float, mat: StandardMaterial3D) -> void:
	var ab := b - a
	var l := ab.length()
	if l < 0.05:
		return
	var d := ab / l
	var n := d.cross(wdir).normalized()
	# garante normal apontando "para cima" (y positivo)
	if n.y < 0.0:
		n = -n
	var size := Vector3(hw * 2.0 + 0.02, 0.8, l + 0.25)
	var pos := (a + b) * 0.5 - n * 0.4
	var basis := Basis(wdir, n, d)
	var mi := _mesh_box(size, pos, mat, basis)
	# colisão trimesh da própria malha (precisa ser convexa simples: box serve)
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.collision_layer = 1
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = size
	cs.shape = shape
	body.add_child(cs)
	body.global_basis = basis
	body.position = pos
	add_child(body)


## Área de grind em grupo "rail": linha A -> B no topo do corrimão.
func _rail(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, thickness := 0.09, posts := true) -> void:
	var ab := b - a
	var l := ab.length()
	if l < 0.5:
		return
	var d := ab / l
	var side := d.cross(Vector3.UP).normalized()

	# barra visual (sem colisão sólida)
	var bar := _mesh_box(Vector3(thickness, thickness, l), (a + b) * 0.5, m_metal, Basis(side, Vector3.UP, d))

	var area := Area3D.new()
	area.collision_layer = 4
	area.collision_mask = 2
	area.add_to_group("rail")
	area.set_meta("a", a)
	area.set_meta("b", b)
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = Vector3(0.5, 1.6, l + 0.6)
	cs.shape = shape
	area.add_child(cs)
	area.position = (a + b) * 0.5 + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
	area.global_basis = Basis(side, Vector3.UP, d)
	add_child(area)

	if posts and props != null:
		var count := int(l / 2.5)
		for i in range(count + 1):
			var t := float(i) / maxf(float(count), 1.0)
			var p := a + ab * t - Vector3(0, 0.45, 0)
			var post := _mesh_box(Vector3(0.08, 0.9, 0.08), p, m_metal, Basis.IDENTITY)
			post.reparent(props)


## Zona de gap (premia ao cruzar no ar).
func _gap(size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, gap_name: String) -> void:
	var area := Area3D.new()
	area.set_script(load("res://scripts/gap.gd"))
	area.collision_layer = 4
	area.collision_mask = 2
	area.set_meta("gap", gap_name)
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = size
	cs.shape = shape
	area.add_child(cs)
	area.position = pos
	add_child(area)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ mundo

func _ground() -> void:
	_box(Vector3(600, 1, 600), Vector3(0, -0.5, 0), m_asphalt)
	# praça mais clara
	var plaza := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var disc := CylinderMesh.new()
	disc.top_radius = 62.0
	disc.bottom_radius = 62.0
	disc.height = 0.06
	plaza.mesh = disc
	plaza.material_override = m_concrete
	plaza.position = Vector3(0, 0.02, 0)
	add_child(plaza)
	# faixas de grama nas bordas (decorativo)
	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		for sz in [-1.0, 1.0]:
			var g := MeshInstance3D.new()
			var gm := BoxMesh.new()
			gm.size = Vector3(190, 0.05, 190)
			g.mesh = gm
			g.material_override = m_grass
			g.position = Vector3(sx * 195, 0.03, sz * 195)
			add_child(g)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ praça central

func _plaza() -> void:
	# fonte: borda circular grindável em volta de uma bacia rasa
	var segments := 16
	var radius := 7.0
	for i in range(segments):
		var t0 := TAU * float(i) / segments
		var t1 := TAU * float(i + 1) / segments
		var a := Vector3(sin(t0) * radius, 0.5, cos(t0) * radius)
		var b := Vector3(sin(t1) * radius, 0.5, cos(t1) * radius)
		_slab(a, b, (b - a).cross(Vector3.UP).normalized(), 0.45, m_concrete2)
		_rail(a + Vector3(0, 0.12, 0), b + Vector3(0, 0.12, 0), 0.07, false)
	# interior da fonte (água decorativa)
	var water := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var wm := CylinderMesh.new()
	wm.top_radius = 5.4
	wm.bottom_radius = 5.4
	wm.height = 0.1
	water.mesh = wm
	water.material_override = m_water
	water.position = Vector3(0, 0.03, 0)
	add_child(water)
	_gap(Vector3(11, 3.4, 11), Vector3(0, 2.4, 0), "da Fonte")

	# bancos grindáveis
	_bench(Vector3(16, 0, 14), 0.9)
	_bench(Vector3(-16, 0, 14), 0.9)
	_bench(Vector3(16, 0, -14), -0.9)
	_bench(Vector3(-16, 0, -14), -0.9)

	# barras planas
	_rail(Vector3(28, 0.65, -6), Vector3(28, 0.65, 6))
	_rail(Vector3(-30, 0.55, 22), Vector3(-14, 0.55, 22))

	# pequeno escalonado da praça (2 degraus + corrimão)
	_box(Vector3(6, 0.4, 4), Vector3(-38, 0.2, -20), m_concrete)
	_box(Vector3(6, 0.8, 4), Vector3(-44, 0.4, -20), m_concrete)
	_rail(Vector3(-40.5, 0.95, -21.6), Vector3(-46.5, 0.55, -21.6))


func _bench(pos: Vector3, yaw: float) -> void:
	var b := _box(Vector3(2.6, 0.45, 0.65), pos + Vector3(0, 0.22, 0), m_wood, yaw)
	var top := 0.45
	var d := Vector3(sin(yaw + PI / 2), 0, cos(yaw + PI / 2))
	var a := pos + d * 1.15 + Vector3(0, top, 0)
	var c := pos - d * 1.15 + Vector3(0, top, 0)
	_rail(a, c, 0.07, false)
	b.reparent(self)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ rua

func _street() -> void:
	# plataforma + escadaria de 8 degraus descendo para leste
	_box(Vector3(30, 1.6, 12), Vector3(155, 0.8, 0), m_concrete)
	for k in range(8):
		var x := 170.0 + 0.4 + k * 0.4
		var h := 1.6 - (k + 1) * 0.2
		_box(Vector3(0.4, h, 10), Vector3(x + 0.2, h / 2.0, 0), m_concrete)
	_gap(Vector3(7, 4.5, 9), Vector3(173, 2.2, 0), "da Escadaria")
	# corrimão descendo a escada
	_rail(Vector3(168.5, 1.85, -5.6), Vector3(175.5, 0.25, -5.6))

	# ledges compridos

func _ledge(pos: Vector3, length: float, yaw: float, height := 0.45) -> void:
	var d := Vector3(sin(yaw + PI / 2), 0, cos(yaw + PI / 2))
	_box(Vector3(length, height, 1.0), pos + Vector3(0, height / 2.0, 0), m_concrete2, yaw)
	_rail(pos + d * (length / 2.0 - 0.5) + Vector3(0, height + 0.08, 0),
			pos - d * (length / 2.0 - 0.5) + Vector3(0, height + 0.08, 0), 0.07, false)


## Kicker: rampa reta de ~25 graus.
func _kicker(pos: Vector3, yaw: float) -> void:
	var fwd := Vector3(-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw))  # direção de subida
	var side := fwd.cross(Vector3.UP)
	var a := pos + fwd * (-1.2)
	var b := pos + fwd * 1.2 + Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)
	_slab(a, b, side, 1.4, m_concrete2)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ bowl

func _bowl() -> void:
	var center := Vector3(-180, 0, 80)
	var radius := 38.0
	var depth := 4.5
	var segments := 26
	for i in range(segments):
		var t0 := TAU * float(i) / segments
		var t1 := TAU * float(i + 1) / segments
		var dir0 := Vector3(sin(t0), 0, cos(t0))
		var dir1 := Vector3(sin(t1), 0, cos(t1))
		var tan := (dir1 - dir0).normalized()
		# perfil: borda -> meio -> fundo
		var rim0 := center + dir0 * radius
		var rim1 := center + dir1 * radius
		var mid_r := radius - depth * 0.35
		var bot_r := radius - depth * 0.75
		# laje superior (rim -> mid, ~60 graus)
		_slab(rim0, center + dir0 * mid_r + Vector3(0, depth * 0.55, 0), tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
		# laje inferior (mid -> fundo, íngreme)
		var a0 := center + dir0 * mid_r + Vector3(0, depth * 0.55, 0)
		var b0 := center + dir0 * bot_r + Vector3(0, -depth, 0)
		_slab(a0, b0, tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
		# laje de fechamento radial entre segmentos (para não vazar entre fatias)
		_slab(rim0, rim1, Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.01, m_concrete2)
	# piso do bowl
	var floor_m := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var fm := CylinderMesh.new()
	fm.top_radius = radius - depth * 0.78
	fm.bottom_radius = radius - depth * 0.78
	fm.height = 0.3
	floor_m.mesh = fm
	floor_m.material_override = m_concrete2
	floor_m.position = center + Vector3(0, -depth - 0.1, 0)
	add_child(floor_m)
	var fbody := StaticBody3D.new()
	fbody.collision_layer = 1
	var fcs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var fshape := CylinderShape3D.new()
	fshape.radius = radius - depth * 0.78
	fshape.height = 0.3
	fcs.shape = fshape
	fbody.add_child(fcs)
	fbody.position = center + Vector3(0, -depth - 0.1, 0)
	add_child(fbody)
	# boca de bueiro do meio (transfer)
	_gap(Vector3(20, 4, 20), center + Vector3(0, 1.8, 0), "do Bowl")
	# deck ao redor
	var deck_m := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var dkm := CylinderMesh.new()
	dkm.top_radius = radius + 3.0
	dkm.bottom_radius = radius + 3.0
	dkm.height = 0.12
	deck_m.mesh = dkm
	deck_m.material_override = m_concrete
	deck_m.position = center + Vector3(0, 0.05, 0)
	add_child(deck_m)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ piscina vazia

func _pool() -> void:
	var center := Vector3(-190, 0, -110)
	var hx := 18.0
	var hz := 14.0
	var depth := 2.6
	var rc := 6.0
	# perímetro arredondado: amostra pontos do retângulo com cantos em arco
	var pts: Array[Vector3] = []
	var steps := 6
	# lados retas + cantos
	var corners := [
		[Vector3(hx - rc, 0, hz - rc), PI / 2],
		[Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, hz - rc), 0.0],
		[Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, -hz + rc), -PI / 2],
		[Vector3(hx - rc, 0, -hz + rc), PI],
	]
	for c in corners:
		var p0: Vector3 = center + c[0]
		var a0: float = c[1]
		for k in range(steps + 1):
			var ang := a0 + (PI / 2.0) * float(k) / steps
			pts.append(p0 + Vector3(sin(ang + PI) , 0, cos(ang + PI)) * 0)  # placeholder evitado abaixo
		pts.pop_back()
	# construção direta: 4 lados retos + 4 arcos
	pts.clear()
	var straight := [
		[Vector3(hx, 0, hz - rc), Vector3(hx, 0, -hz + rc)],
		[Vector3(-hx, 0, -hz + rc), Vector3(-hx, 0, hz - rc)],
		[Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, hz), Vector3(hx - rc, 0, hz)],
		[Vector3(hx - rc, 0, -hz), Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, -hz)],
	]
	var arcs := [
		[Vector3(hx - rc, 0, hz - rc), 0.0, PI / 2.0],
		[Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, hz - rc), PI / 2.0, PI],
		[Vector3(-hx + rc, 0, -hz + rc), PI, PI * 1.5],
		[Vector3(hx - rc, 0, -hz + rc), PI * 1.5, TAU],
	]
	var path: Array[Vector3] = []
	for s in straight:
		for k in range(4):
			path.append(center + s[0].lerp(s[1], float(k) / 3.0))
	for ar in arcs:
		for k in range(5):
			var ang: float = ar[1] + (ar[2] - ar[1]) * float(k) / 4.0
			var p: Vector3 = center + ar[0] + Vector3(sin(ang), 0, cos(ang)) * rc
			path.append(p)
	# paredes: rim -> meio -> fundo ao longo do caminho fechado
	var n := path.size()
	for i in range(n):
		var pa: Vector3 = path[i]
		var pb: Vector3 = path[(i + 1) % n]
		var tan := (pb - pa).normalized()
		# direção para dentro
		var inward := tan.cross(Vector3.UP)
		var mid_c: Vector3 = (pa + pb) * 0.5
		if inward.dot(center - mid_c) < 0.0:
			inward = -inward
		var rim_a := pa
		var rim_b := pb
		var mid_a := pa + inward * depth * 0.35 + Vector3(0, -depth * 0.45, 0)
		var mid_b := pb + inward * depth * 0.35 + Vector3(0, -depth * 0.45, 0)
		var bot_a := pa + inward * depth * 0.8 + Vector3(0, -depth, 0)
		var bot_b := pb + inward * depth * 0.8 + Vector3(0, -depth, 0)
		_slab(rim_a, mid_a, tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
		_slab(mid_a, bot_a, tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
		_slab(rim_a, rim_b, Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.01, m_concrete2)
	# piso
	var fl := _box(Vector3((hx - depth * 0.85) * 2.0, 0.3, (hz - depth * 0.85) * 2.0), center + Vector3(0, -depth - 0.15, 0), m_concrete2)
	fl.reparent(self)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ túnel

func _tunnel() -> void:
	var c := Vector3(120, 0, -150)
	# morro em degraus
	_box(Vector3(46, 3, 30), c + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0), m_grass)
	_box(Vector3(38, 3, 26), c + Vector3(0, 4.5, 0), m_grass)
	_box(Vector3(26, 2, 18), c + Vector3(0, 7.0, 0), m_grass)
	# passagem no eixo X
	_box(Vector3(40, 4.2, 1.2), c + Vector3(0, 2.1, 5.2), m_dark)
	_box(Vector3(40, 4.2, 1.2), c + Vector3(0, 2.1, -5.2), m_dark)
	_box(Vector3(40, 1.4, 11.6), c + Vector3(0, 4.9, 0), m_dark)
	# kicker dentro do túnel para o gap
	_kicker(c + Vector3(-9, 0, 0), 0.0)
	_gap(Vector3(20, 3.2, 8), c + Vector3(0, 2.0, 0), "do Túnel")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ quartos de onda

## QP curvo. `facing` = ângulo yaw da normal da parede (direção para onde aponta).
func _quarter(pos: Vector3, width: float, height: float, facing: float) -> void:
	var n := Vector3(sin(facing), 0, cos(facing))   # normal (para fora da parede)
	var tan := n.cross(Vector3.UP)                  # largura da parede
	var steps := 6
	var r := height
	var prev_a: Vector3
	var prev_b: Vector3
	for k in range(steps + 1):
		var ang := (PI / 2.0) * float(k) / steps
		# sobe a parede: no fim (ang=90°) a boca fica em cima, na base é vertical
		var s := r * (1.0 - cos(ang))
		var y := r * sin(ang)
		var base := pos + n * (-s * 0.0)
		# pontos de borda da curva (superfície externa para cima da rampa)
		var a := pos - tan * (width / 2.0) + n * s + Vector3(0, y, 0)
		var b := pos + tan * (width / 2.0) + n * s + Vector3(0, y, 0)
		if k > 0:
			_slab(prev_a, a, tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
			_slab(prev_b, b, tan, 0.01, m_concrete)
			_slab(prev_a, prev_b, Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.01, m_concrete2)
			_slab(a, b, Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0.01, m_concrete2)
		prev_a = a
		prev_b = b
	# boca (coping decorativo)
	if props != null:
		var cop := _mesh_box(Vector3(width + 0.2, 0.12, 0.12),
				pos + n * r + Vector3(0, height, 0), m_metal,
				Basis(tan, Vector3.UP, n))
		cop.reparent(props)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ cercas

func _fences() -> void:
	for i in range(4):
		var yaw := PI / 2.0 * float(i)
		var d := Vector3(sin(yaw), 0, cos(yaw))
		_box(Vector3(600, 2.4, 1.0), d * 299.0 + Vector3(0, 1.2, 0), m_dark, yaw + PI / 2.0)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ decorativos

func _props_decor() -> void:
	# árvores
	var spots := [
		Vector3(-60, 0, -90), Vector3(-90, 0, -60), Vector3(60, 0, 90),
		Vector3(90, 0, 60), Vector3(-240, 0, 180), Vector3(240, 0, 180),
		Vector3(-240, 0, -200), Vector3(250, 0, -60), Vector3(-60, 0, 200),
		Vector3(60, 0, -220), Vector3(-230, 0, 0), Vector3(230, 0, 0),
	]
	for p in spots:
		_tree(p)
	# postes de luz
	for i in range(8):
		var ang := TAU * float(i) / 8.0
		_lamp(Vector3(sin(ang) * 90.0, 0, cos(ang) * 90.0))


func _tree(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	var trunk := _mesh_box(Vector3(0.5, 3.0, 0.5), pos + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0), m_trunk, Basis.IDENTITY)
	var crown := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cm := SphereMesh.new()
	cm.radius = 1.8
	cm.height = 3.6
	crown.mesh = cm
	crown.material_override = m_leaf
	crown.position = pos + Vector3(0, 4.4, 0)
	add_child(crown)
	trunk.reparent(props)
	crown.reparent(props)


func _lamp(pos: Vector3) -> void:
	var post := _mesh_box(Vector3(0.15, 6.0, 0.15), pos + Vector3(0, 3.0, 0), m_dark, Basis.IDENTITY)
	var arm := _mesh_box(Vector3(0.15, 0.15, 1.2), pos + Vector3(0, 6.0, 0.5), m_dark, Basis.IDENTITY)
	post.reparent(props)
	arm.reparent(props)

input.content:
extends CanvasLayer
## HUD: placar, combo, popups de manobra, barra de equilíbrio,
## velocidade e controles de toque (Android).

var score_label: Label
var mult_label: Label
var speed_label: Label
var popup_box: VBoxContainer
var balance_panel: Panel
var balance_fill: ColorRect
var touch_root: Control
var pause_btn: Panel

var player: CharacterBody3D
var pause_callback: Callable

# estado do toque
var stick_id := -1
var stick_origin := Vector2.ZERO
var stick_knob: Panel
var stick_base: Panel
var buttons := {}  # nome -> {panel, label, rect}


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 10
	_build_labels()
	_build_balance()
	_build_touch()


func _build_labels() -> void:
	score_label = _label(34, Color.WHITE)
	score_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	score_label.offset_left = -420.0
	score_label.offset_top = 12.0
	score_label.offset_right = -16.0
	score_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	add_child(score_label)

	mult_label = _label(22, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2))
	mult_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	mult_label.offset_left = -420.0
	mult_label.offset_top = 56.0
	mult_label.offset_right = -16.0
	mult_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	add_child(mult_label)

	speed_label = _label(18, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
	speed_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	speed_label.offset_left = 16.0
	speed_label.offset_top = 12.0
	add_child(speed_label)

	popup_box = VBoxContainer.new()
	popup_box.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	popup_box.offset_left = -300.0
	popup_box.offset_right = 300.0
	popup_box.offset_top = -170.0
	popup_box.offset_bottom = -20.0
	popup_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END
	add_child(popup_box)

	Game.score_changed.connect(_on_score)
	Game.trick_popup.connect(_on_popup)
	_on_score(Game.score, Game.pending, Game.mult)


func _label(size: int, color: Color) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8))
	l.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
	return l


func _build_balance() -> void:
	balance_panel = Panel.new()
	balance_panel.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	balance_panel.offset_left = -150.0
	balance_panel.offset_right = 150.0
	balance_panel.offset_top = -60.0
	balance_panel.offset_bottom = -44.0
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	sb.corner_radius_top_left = 6
	sb.corner_radius_top_right = 6
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_left = 6
	sb.corner_radius_bottom_right = 6
	balance_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	balance_panel.visible = false
	add_child(balance_panel)

	balance_fill = ColorRect.new()
	balance_fill.color = Color(0.2, 0.9, 0.4)
	balance_fill.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	balance_fill.offset_left = 70.0
	balance_fill.offset_right = 70.0
	balance_panel.add_child(balance_fill)


func _build_touch() -> void:
	if not DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available():
		return
	touch_root = Control.new()
	touch_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	touch_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(touch_root)

	# base do analógico (visual)
	stick_base = _circle(Vector2(190, 190), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14))
	stick_base.position = Vector2(140, -240)
	stick_base.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_LEFT)
	stick_base.visible = false
	touch_root.add_child(stick_base)
	stick_knob = _circle(Vector2(90, 90), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35))
	stick_knob.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_LEFT)
	stick_knob.visible = false
	touch_root.add_child(stick_knob)

	_button("ollie", "SALTAR", Vector2(-110, -110), 130)
	_button("trick", "MANOBRA", Vector2(-250, -70), 100)
	_button("grind", "GRIND", Vector2(-95, -260), 96)

	# botão de pausa
	pause_btn = _circle(Vector2(56, 56), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45))
	pause_btn.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	pause_btn.position = Vector2(-70, 14)
	var pl := _label(14, Color.WHITE)
	pl.text = "II"
	pl.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	pl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	pl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	pause_btn.add_child(pl)
	touch_root.add_child(pause_btn)


func _circle(size: Vector2, color: Color) -> Panel:
	var p := Panel.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = color
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(int(minf(size.x, size.y) / 2.0))
	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	p.custom_minimum_size = size
	p.size = size
	p.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return p


func _button(name: String, text: String, pos: Vector2, size: float) -> void:
	var p := _circle(Vector2(size, size), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2))
	p.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_RIGHT)
	p.position = pos
	var l := _label(int(size * 0.16), Color.WHITE)
	l.text = text
	l.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	l.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	p.add_child(l)
	touch_root.add_child(p)
	buttons[name] = {"panel": p, "size": size}


func _btn_center(b: Dictionary) -> Vector2:
	var p: Panel = b.panel
	var vp := touch_root.get_viewport_rect().size
	return vp + p.position + p.size * 0.5


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ toque

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if touch_root == null:
		return
	var vp := touch_root.get_viewport_rect().size
	if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if event.pressed:
			if event.position.x < vp.x * 0.45 and event.position.y > vp.y * 0.35 and stick_id == -1:
				stick_id = event.index
				stick_origin = event.position
				stick_base.visible = true
				stick_knob.visible = true
				_update_stick_visual(stick_origin)
			else:
				for name in buttons:
					if event.position.distance_to(_btn_center(buttons[name])) < buttons[name].size * 0.6:
						InputHub.touch_button(name, true)
						(buttons[name].panel as Panel).modulate = Color(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
						break
				if pause_btn != null and event.position.distance_to(_pause_center()) < 50.0:
					if pause_callback.is_valid():
						pause_callback.call()
		else:
			if event.index == stick_id:
				stick_id = -1
				InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2.ZERO)
				stick_base.visible = false
				stick_knob.visible = false
			else:
				for name in buttons:
					if event.position.distance_to(_btn_center(buttons[name])) < buttons[name].size * 0.7:
						InputHub.touch_button(name, false)
						(buttons[name].panel as Panel).modulate = Color.WHITE
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag and event.index == stick_id:
		var v := (event.position - stick_origin) / 70.0
		if v.length() > 1.0:
			v = v.normalized()
		InputHub.touch_stick(v)
		_update_stick_visual(stick_origin + v * 70.0)


func _pause_center() -> Vector2:
	var vp := touch_root.get_viewport_rect().size
	return vp + pause_btn.position + pause_btn.size * 0.5


func _update_stick_visual(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var vp := touch_root.get_viewport_rect().size
	stick_base.position = stick_origin - Vector2(95, 95) - vp * Vector2(0, 1)
	# (posição calculada relativa ao canto inferior esquerdo)
	stick_base.position = stick_origin - Vector2(95, vp.y - 95)
	stick_knob.position = pos - Vector2(45, vp.y - 45)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ atualização

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if player != null and is_instance_valid(player):
		var spd := Vector3(player.velocity.x, 0, player.velocity.z).length() * 3.6
		speed_label.text = "%d km/h" % int(spd)
		var b: float = player.get_balance()
		if is_nan(b):
			balance_panel.visible = false
		else:
			balance_panel.visible = true
			var w := balance_panel.size.x
			var mid := w * 0.5
			var half := mid - 8.0
			balance_fill.offset_left = mid + b * half * 0.5
			balance_fill.offset_right = mid - b * half * 0.5
			balance_fill.color = Color(0.2, 0.9, 0.4).lerp(Color(0.95, 0.2, 0.15), absf(b))


func _on_score(score: int, pending: int, mult: int) -> void:

extends Node3D
## Main: monta o mundo, o jogador, a HUD, os perfis de qualidade
## e os menus (início + pausa).

var player: CharacterBody3D
var hud: CanvasLayer
var park: Node3D
var world_env: WorldEnvironment
var env: Environment
var sun: DirectionalLight3D

var menu_layer: CanvasLayer
var start_panel: Control
var pause_panel: Control
var started := false


func _init() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_environment()

	park = load("res://scripts/park_builder.gd").new()
	park.name = "Park"
	add_child(park)
	park.build()

	player = load("res://scripts/player.gd").new()
	player.name = "Player"
	player.position = Vector3(0, 0.6, 42)
	player.facing = 0.0  # de frente para a fonte
	add_child(player)

	hud = load("res://scripts/hud.gd").new()
	add_child(hud)
	hud.player = player
	hud.pause_callback = _toggle_pause

	_apply_quality()
	Settings.profile_changed.connect(_apply_quality)

	_build_menus()
	get_tree().paused = true


func _build_environment() -> void:
	env = Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky := Sky.new()
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color(0.24, 0.5, 0.85)
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.76, 0.85, 0.93)
	sky_mat.ground_bottom_color = Color(0.35, 0.36, 0.33)
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.72, 0.78, 0.82)
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	env.ambient_light_sky_contribution = 1.0
	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
	world_env = WorldEnvironment.new()
	world_env.environment = env
	add_child(world_env)

	sun = DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-52.0, 38.0, 0.0)
	sun.light_energy = 1.25
	sun.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.96, 0.88)
	add_child(sun)


func _apply_quality() -> void:
	var q: int = Settings.profile
	sun.shadow_enabled = q >= 1
	if q >= 1:
		sun.directional_shadow_mode = DirectionalLight3D.SHADOW_PARALLEL_2_SPLITS if q == 1 else DirectionalLight3D.SHADOW_PARALLEL_4_SPLITS
		sun.directional_shadow_max_distance = 160.0 if q == 1 else 280.0
	env.fog_enabled = q >= 1
	env.fog_light_color = Color(0.72, 0.78, 0.85)
	env.fog_density = 0.0012
	env.glow_enabled = q >= 2
	get_viewport().msaa_3d = [Viewport.MSAA_DISABLED, Viewport.MSAA_2X, Viewport.MSAA_4X][q]
	if park != null:
		park.props.visible = q >= 1


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ menus

func _build_menus() -> void:
	menu_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
	menu_layer.layer = 20
	menu_layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(menu_layer)

	start_panel = _menu_panel(false)
	pause_panel = _menu_panel(true)
	pause_panel.visible = false


func _menu_panel(is_pause: bool) -> Control:
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.1, 0.82)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	menu_layer.add_child(dim)

	var center := CenterContainer.new()
	center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.add_child(center)

	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.12, 0.15, 0.2, 0.96)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	sb.content_margin_left = 34.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 34.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 24.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 24.0
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	center.add_child(panel)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	vb.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(430, 0)
	panel.add_child(vb)

	if not is_pause:
		var title := Label.new()
		title.text = "AURORA SKATE PARK"
		title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
		title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.25))
		title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		vb.add_child(title)
		var sub := Label.new()
		sub.text = "Parque original de 600 x 600 m\nCorrimãos, bowls, manuals e gaps"
		sub.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 17)
		sub.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.8, 0.85, 0.9))
		sub.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		vb.add_child(sub)

	_vspace(vb, 6)
	_quality_row(vb)

	if is_pause:
		_vspace(vb, 8)
		_menu_button(vb, "Continuar", func() -> void: _toggle_pause())
		_menu_button(vb, "Recomeçar", _restart)

	_vspace(vb, 8)
	var start_btn := _menu_button(vb, "SKATINAR!", _start_game)
	if is_pause:
		start_btn.visible = false

	_vspace(vb, 10)
	var hint := Label.new()
	hint.text = "Analógico esquerdo: empurrar e virar  ·  SALTAR: ollie (segure p/ alto)\nMANOBRA: flips e shove-its no ar  ·  GRIND: grind no corrimão / manual no chão\nDesktop: WASD + Espaço + J + K  ·  R volta ao último ponto seguro"
	hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	hint.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.65, 0.7, 0.78))
	hint.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(hint)
	return dim


func _vspace(vb: VBoxContainer, h: float) -> void:
	var c := Control.new()
	c.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, h)
	vb.add_child(c)


func _quality_row(vb: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var lbl := Label.new()
	lbl.text = "Qualidade gráfica"
	lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(lbl)

	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	vb.add_child(row)
	var group := ButtonGroup.new()
	for i in range(3):
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = Settings.PROFILES[i]
		b.toggle_mode = true
		b.button_group = group
		b.button_pressed = i == Settings.profile
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(110, 44)
		b.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			Settings.set_profile(i)
			_apply_quality())
		row.add_child(b)


func _menu_button(vb: VBoxContainer, text: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = text
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 52)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	b.pressed.connect(cb)
	vb.add_child(b)
	return b


func _start_game() -> void:
	started = true
	start_panel.visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	Game.reset()


func _toggle_pause() -> void:
	if not started:
		return
	var paused := not get_tree().paused
	get_tree().paused = paused
	pause_panel.visible = paused


func _restart() -> void:
	Game.reset()
	get_tree().paused = false
	get_tree().reload_current_scene()


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("pause") and started:
		_toggle_pause()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

# Aurora Skate Park — jogo de skate 3D (Godot 4.x, Android)

Jogo de skate 3D **original** (identidade visual, mapa, nomes e sons próprios),
inspirado na mecânica de jogos de skate com controle analógico. Roda em Godot 4.3+
com o renderer **Mobile** e foi feito para escalar em três perfis de qualidade.

## Como jogar

| Ação | Toque (Android) | Teclado (desktop) |
|---|---|---|
| Empurrar / virar | analógico esquerdo | `W/S` + `A/D` (ou setas) |
| Ollie (segure para pular mais alto) | botão SALTAR | `Espaço` |
| Flips / shove-its (no ar) | botão MANOBRA + direção do analógico | `J` + direção |
| Grind (no corrimão) / Manual (no chão, segura) | botão GRIND | `K` |
| Spin no ar | inclinar o analógico no ar | `A/D` no ar |
| Voltar ao ponto seguro | — | `R` |
| Pausar | botão II | `Esc` |

Manobras: **Kickflip** (J + lado), **Heelflip** (J + cima), **Pop Shove-it** (J sem direção),
**360 Shove-it** (J + baixo). Gaps premiam +500 (fonte, escadaria, túnel, bowl).
Aterrar com a manobra incompleta ou de lado causa **queda** e zera a combo.

## Estrutura

```
aurora-skate/
├── project.godot          # config (renderer Mobile, autoloads, orientação landscape)
├── export_presets.cfg     # preset Android (APK) — complete assinatura no editor
├── scenes/main.tscn       # cena raiz mínima; o resto é gerado por código
└── scripts/
    ├── main.gd            # mundo, ambiente, perfis de qualidade, menus
    ├── park_builder.gd    # parque 600x600 m procedural (praça, rua, bowl, piscina, túnel)
    ├── player.gd          # física do skate: ollie, flips, spins, grinds, manuals, quedas
    ├── game.gd            # pontuação, combos, gaps (autoload)
    ├── input_hub.gd       # une toque + teclado (autoload)
    ├── hud.gd             # placar, popups, barra de equilíbrio, controles de toque
    ├── settings.gd        # perfil Baixo/Médio/Alto (autoload)
    └── gap.gd             # zonas de gap
```

## Perfis de qualidade (compatibilidade escalável)

- **Baixo**: sem sombras, sem MSAA, sem névoa, props decorativos removidos (as linhas
  de skate não mudam).
- **Médio**: sombras 2-split (160 m), MSAA 2x, névoa leve, props ligados.
- **Alto**: sombras 4-split (280 m), MSAA 4x, brilho, tudo ligado.

Para medir por modelo de aparelho, use Android GPU Inspector / Perfetto:
https://developer.android.com/games/optimize/overview

## Exportar para Android

1. Instale **OpenJDK 17** e o **Android SDK** (pacotes listados na doc oficial):
   https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.html
2. No Godot: *Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android*, aponte `Java SDK Path`
   e `Android SDK Path`.
3. *Project → Export → Android* (o preset já está em `export_presets.cfg`), configure
   o **keystore** (debug ou release) e exporte APK ou AAB.

## Suposições da versão atual

- Sem áudio ainda (nenhum asset de som incluído).
- Mapa único fechado (600 x 600 m) — não mundo aberto.
- Modelos low-poly gerados por código (sem GLTF externo).
- Renderer Mobile; perfis ajustam sombras/MSAA/props, não resolução dinâmica.

Also `_update_stick_visual` had odd math (position with anchors). Position assignment overrides anchors so simple math works. Let me fix that function:

```gdscript
func _update_stick_visual(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	stick_base.position = stick_origin - Vector2(95, 95)
	stick_knob.position = pos - Vector2(45, 45)
```

Wait — position for control with anchors preset BOTTOM_LEFT: assigning `position` sets offsets relative to anchors... In Godot 4, Control.position is "the position relative to the parent's origin" — the setter `set_position` computes offsets so the node lands there. Yes, position is always parent-relative topleft. So simplify.

extends Node
## Harness de teste/dev: carrega o jogo real, simula toques no InputHub,
## captura screenshots e imprime o estado do jogador. Não faz parte do jogo.

var main: Node3D
var t := 0.0
var started := false
var step := 0
var shots: Array[String] = []
var log_lines: Array[String] = []


func _init() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS


func _ready() -> void:
	main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(main)


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	var img := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
	img.resize(960, 540, Image.INTERPOLATE_BILINEAR)
	var path := "/tmp/opencode/shots/%s.jpg" % name
	img.save_jpg(path, 80)
	shots.append(path)


func _input_hub_press(name: String, dur: float) -> void:
	InputHub.touch_button(name, true)
	var timer := get_tree().create_timer(dur)
	timer.timeout.connect(func() -> void: InputHub.touch_button(name, false))


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	var p: CharacterBody3D = main.player
	if p != null and Engine.get_process_frames() % 30 == 0:
		var spd := Vector3(p.velocity.x, 0, p.velocity.z).length()
		var line := "t=%.1f pos=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) state=%d speed=%.1f" % [t, p.global_position.x, p.global_position.y, p.global_position.z, p.state, spd]
		log_lines.append(line)

	if not started and t > 0.4:
		started = true
		_shot("01_menu")
		main._start_game()

	if not started:
		return

	match step:
		0:
			if t > 0.6:
				step = 1
		1:  # empurra em direção à fonte
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(0, -1))
			if t > 3.0:
				InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2.ZERO)
				_input_hub_press("ollie", 0.25)
				step = 2
		2:  # kickflip no ar
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(-1, 0))
			if t > 3.35:
				InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2.ZERO)
				_input_hub_press("trick", 0.05)
				step = 3
		3:
			if t > 4.2:
				_shot("02_trick_air")
				step = 4
		4:  # empurra em direção à barra plana (x=28)
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(0.7, -1))
			if t > 7.5:
				InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(0, -1))
				step = 5
		5:
			if t > 9.5:
				_shot("03_ride")
				step = 6
		6:
			if t > 11.0:
				_shot("04_end")
				for l in log_lines:
					print(l)
				print("SCORE=", Game.score, " PENDING=", Game.pending, " MULT=", Game.mult)
				for s in shots:
					print("SHOT=", s)
				get_tree().quit()

var main: Node3D
var t := 0.0
var started := false
var phase := 0
var shots: Array[String] = []
var log_lines: Array[String] = []
var flags := {}


func _init() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS


func _ready() -> void:
	main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(main)


func _shot(name: String) -> void:
	var img := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
	img.resize(960, 540, Image.INTERPOLATE_BILINEAR)
	var path := "/tmp/opencode/shots/%s.jpg" % name
	img.save_jpg(path, 80)
	shots.append(path)


func _teleport(p: CharacterBody3D, pos: Vector3, facing: float) -> void:
	p.global_position = pos
	p.facing = facing
	p.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	p.state = 0
	p.safe_pos = pos
	p.charge = -1.0


func _press(name: String, dur: float) -> void:
	InputHub.touch_button(name, true)
	var timer := get_tree().create_timer(dur)
	timer.timeout.connect(func() -> void: InputHub.touch_button(name, false))


func _steer_towards(p: CharacterBody3D, target: Vector3) -> Vector2:
	var dir := target - p.global_position
	dir.y = 0.0
	var want := atan2(-dir.x, -dir.z)
	var err := wrapf(want - p.facing, -PI, PI)
	return Vector2(clampf(-err * 2.5, -1.0, 1.0), -1.0)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	var p: CharacterBody3D = main.player

	var pos := p.global_position
	match phase:

		1:

			if t > 6.0:

		2:

			if p.state == 1 and absf(pos.z) < 5.0 and not flags.has("fonte"):

				_shot("02_fonte_gap")
			if p.state == 0 and pos.z < -8.0:
				phase = 3
			if t > 10.0:
				phase = 3
		3:
			if t > 10.6:
				phase = 4
		4:  # túnel: entra pelo oeste e usa o kicker
			_teleport(p, Vector3(92, 0.8, -150), -PI / 2.0)
			phase = 5
		5:
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(0, -1))
			if pos.x > 132.0 and pos.y > 0.6 and not flags.has("tunel"):
				flags["tunel"] = true
				_shot("03_tunel")
			if pos.x > 145.0 or p.state == 4:
				phase = 6
			if t > 14.0:
				phase = 6
		6:
			if t > 14.6:
				phase = 7
		7:  # bowl: cai e patina
			_teleport(p, Vector3(-180, 0.8, 126), 0.0)
			phase = 8
		8:
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2(0, -1))
			if pos.y < -2.0 and not flags.has("bowl"):
				flags["bowl"] = true
				_shot("04_bowl")
			if t > 20.0:
				phase = 9
		9:
			if t > 20.6:
				phase = 10
		10:  # rua: vai até o ledge e tenta grind
			_teleport(p, Vector3(180, 0.8, -20), 0.0)
			phase = 11
		11:
			InputHub.touch_stick(_steer_towards(p, Vector3(200, 0, -42)))
			if (p.global_position - Vector3(200, 0, -42)).length() < 12.0 and p.state == 0 and p.velocity.length() > 6.0:
				_press("ollie", 0.2)
				phase = 12
			if t > 26.0:
				phase = 14
		12:
			InputHub.touch_stick(Vector2.ZERO)
			if p.state == 2 and not flags.has("ledge"):
				flags["ledge"] = true
				_shot("05_ledge_grind")
			if t > 29.0:
				phase = 13
		13:
			if t > 29.6:

		14:
			InputHub.release_all()

			for s in shots:

			get_tree().quit()
